instructionsMarkdown:
# Unity C# Game Systems Architecture & Performance

Engineer responsive, scalable game architectures in Unity with zero garbage collection spikes.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Forbid heap allocations (`new`, LINQ, string concatenation) inside `Update()` and `FixedUpdate()`.
- Use `ScriptableObject`s for modular, data-driven architecture and decoupled event channels.
- Implement object pooling for all dynamic entities (projectiles, particles, enemies).
- Profile regularly using the Unity Memory Profiler to guarantee target frame-time budgets (60/120 FPS).
